description: Did that Arc payment really land? Payer, recipient, amount in both of Arc's transfer forms (the ERC-20 view and the native log), confirmation and gas, checked against what you expected. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

expect.description: optional expected amount in USDC, e.g. 1.50

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_payment_check
